name: realm-play
description: Desktop-only, source-only local REALM MCP integration for one host-bound player.

interface.longDescription: Source-only desktop plugin for an authenticated player's local REALM Gateway and Engine. The current MCP backend advertises nine tools; a two-tool read-only pilot requires a separate host-enforced allowlist before installation. Needs matching REALM source, an existing world, a host-owned player token and a compatible local Python MCP host. Does not connect ChatGPT Web or install a remote service.
interface.defaultPrompt: If local REALM MCP tools are actually available and host-qualified, call realm_status and realm_look only to observe the bound player and world. Do not join, mutate, access history or map, or assume the plugin package grants host permission.
